integrity: The exact value is proved by a complete boundary/support-functional classification; numerical agreement with the published decimal is only a consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The statement is specific to the real mixed cubic–taxicab plane. The literature search is not an exhaustive proof of novelty; the 2016 same-space James-constant article was available only at abstract level.
title: Exact orthogonal Schäffer constant of the mixed cubic–taxicab plane
